question: Does the first-party Fujifilm Velvia 50 composite MTF remain stable across two exact official document revisions and remain materially separated from every existing VISION3 stock under one frozen composite-MTF comparison?

comparison.kodak_composite: geometric mean of blue, green and red response at each common frequency
comparison.interpolation: linear in log10 spatial frequency and natural-log response
comparison.metric: root mean square difference of normalized natural-log response

stop_rules: Do not tune trace points, frequencies, normalization, composite rule or gates after any score.
Failure closes this exact cross-manufacturer source signature without curve-capacity or threshold rescue.
Pass may retain a non-renderable source-domain Velvia observation only; it cannot open a PSF, NPS, RGB transform, stock calibration, photographic render or product profile.
claim_ceiling: First-party manufacturer-graph Velvia 50 revision stability and source-domain composite-MTF separation under explicit E-6/ECN-2 and composite/layer confounds; not independent rolls, process/scanner calibration, colour response, NPS, microscopic structure, photographic appearance or product evidence.
